announcements.headline: Interim report January – September 2026
announcements.insight: GARO AB presents its interim report for January to September 2026. This follows the earlier June results and the October announcement to discontinue the Entity product family.

announcements.headline: Presentation of the interim report January - September 2026 on November 13
announcements.insight: GARO AB presents its interim report for January - September 2026. This follows the June 2026 results and the October 2026 strategic shift to electrification.

announcements.headline: Nomination Committee ahead of the 2027 Annual General Meeting appointed
announcements.insight: The Nomination Committee appointment ahead of the 2027 AGM follows the CEO's warrant acquisition and product discontinuation. This signals ongoing governance preparations.

announcements.headline: GARO to discontinue GARO Entity product family and intensify focus on Electrification
announcements.insight: GARO discontinues its Entity product family to intensify focus on Electrification. This strategic shift follows CEO Tobias Byfeldt’s warrant acquisition and the June 2026 interim report.

announcements.headline: Interim report January – June 2026
announcements.insight: GARO AB released its interim report for January to June 2026. This follows CEO Tobias Byfeldt acquiring warrants in July 2026.

announcements.headline: CEO Tobias Byfeldt acquires warrants in GARO
announcements.insight: CEO Tobias Byfeldt acquires warrants in GARO. This director dealing suggests personal confidence but lacks financial context for shareholders.
